text.告诉 AI 你想要什么，其余交给它: Tell AI what you want — leave the rest to it
text.点击画面查看提示词和参数: click the frame for its prompt & settings
text.点击监看画面查看提示词和参数: Click the monitor for the prompt and settings
text.选择镜头、场景组或剧本文字，查看它的全部素材。: Select a shot, a scene group, or a script line to see everything it was built from.
text.一页看完全部规范和样张。顶部切换配色、语言和设备；样张都能操作。把鼠标移到屏幕最: Every rule and sample on one page. Switch scheme, language and device up top; every sample works. Move the pointer to the far left edge for the table of contents. All data is fictional.
text.之后讨论只用这些词。一个词只指一件事。: Discussions use only these words. One word, one meaning.
text.一个应用的整块界面，所有组件都摆在它上面。: The whole surface of an app; every component sits on it.
text.例：下面第 05 节的整个深色面板。: e.g. the entire panel in section 05.
text.一个功能单元，有自己的面板和状态，可开可藏。: A functional unit with its own panel and states; it can open and hide.
text.组件里的最小操作件。: The smallest operable part of a component.
text.例：发送按钮、分段切换、开关。: e.g. send button, segmented switch, toggle.
text.组件待机时留下的最小部分，点它或移上去才展开。: What remains at rest; it expands only on hover or click.
text.例：对话组件待机只剩一行灰字。: e.g. resting chat is one line of grey text.
text.对话组件：透明度 .72，无阴影，无按钮。: Chat: opacity .72, no shadow, no buttons.
text.鼠标移上去，停 .15s 才响应。只预告，不展开内容。: Pointer over it; reacts after .15s. Previews only, expands nothing.
text.对话组件：浮起，出现阴影，不出现历史。: Chat: lifts, gains a shadow, shows no history.
text.点进去。立刻响应，组件完全展开并固定。: Clicked in. Responds at once, expands fully and stays.
text.对话组件：加宽到 80%，出现历史和发送。: Chat: widens to 80%, shows history and send.
text.鼠标移到别的有交互的组件上时，自己降到透明度 .3，仍可点击。: Lowers to .3 while the pointer is on another interactive component; still clickable.
text.悬停时间线时，对话组件和正文变暗。: Hovering the timeline dims chat and text.
text.因为冲突而完全让出位置，不可点击。: Gives up its place entirely because of a conflict; not clickable.
text.对话聚焦时，时间线高度变 0 并淡出。: When chat is focused, the timeline collapses and fades.
text.小块实色，表示当前选中。: A small solid block marking the current selection.
text.大块柔光卡片，每屏最多一张。: A large soft-lit card; at most one per screen.
text.表达数据的灰色点阵。: A grey dot matrix that expresses data.
text.比面板略深的成组底色，默认无边框无阴影。: A grouping tone just off the panel; no border or shadow by default.
text.离开文档流、带阴影的表面。: A surface out of flow, with a shadow.
text.被挖低的底座和其中被选中的按钮。: A sunken base and the selected button inside it.
text.别人缩小，把位置让出来。用于两者要同时看。: Others shrink to make room. For reading both together.
text.上下文面板打开，阅读列让位并一起居中。: Context panel opens; the reading column yields and both recentre.
text.盖在别人上面，别人不动。用于临时查看。: Sits on top; the rest stays still. For temporary views.
text.聊天历史盖住正文下部。: Chat history covers the lower text.
text.整个离开。用于两者争同一块位置。: Leaves entirely. For two claims on the same place.
text.算作\"还在组件里\"的全部区域。点到范围外才退出聚焦。: All areas that count as inside the component. Only a click outside ends focus.
text.对话组件展开历史记录时。: The chat component with its history open.
text.点开后展开了内容、占了位置。鼠标移走后别的组件继续变暗，点外面才结束。: Opened, it has expanded and taken space. Others stay dim after the pointer leaves, until a click outside.
text.点 Income：详情在原地展开，其他组件挤到右边，看板总尺寸不变，右边的组件照: Click Income: the detail opens in place, the others are pushed to the right, the board keeps its size, and the ones on the right stay usable. Click ✕, click outside the board or press Esc to collapse.
text.组件没有任何可触发的交互。悬停只出阴影，别的组件不变暗。: The component has nothing to trigger. Hover only adds a shadow; others do not dim.
text.真实的记录表：排序、筛选、搜索、勾选和批量操作、行内操作、展开详情、改列宽、显示: A real table of records: sort, filter, search, select with bulk actions, row actions, expanding detail, column resizing, showing and hiding columns, density and paging. The table keeps its height when paging and filtering.
text.点一行展开详情，详情把下面的行挤开；点表格外或按 Esc 收起。按住 Shift: Click a row to expand its detail, which pushes the rows below it; click outside the table or press Esc to close. Hold Shift to select a range. Drag a header's right edge to resize a column.
text.每张图放进当前最短的一列。筛选和换图大小时图片滑到新位置；往下滚动自动加载，占位: Each image goes into the shortest column. Images slide to their new places when you filter or change size. Scrolling down loads more, and placeholders hold the real proportions first, so the page does not jump.
text.给这条记录写点什么: Write a note on this record
text.每个角色只做一件事，只安装你需要的。: Each role does one job. Install only what you need.
text.定时静帧预览，无视频或音频渲染: Timed still preview; no rendered video or audio
text.静帧构图研究，非视频备选条次: Still framing studies, not alternate video takes
text.音频提示记录，无音频渲染: Audio cue record; no rendered audio
text.备选构图研究 · 同源静帧: Alternate framing study · same source still
text.复制失败，请手动复制名称: Copy failed. Select and copy the name manually.
text.通知从上方滑入，不挤正文: Notifications slide in from above without moving content
text.复制失败，请手动复制: Copy failed. Please copy the text manually.
text.按钮、输入、选择、反馈。可操作控件与样式示例。: Buttons, inputs, choices and feedback. Working controls and style previews.
text.互相争整块表面的组件之间，前一个退出 .5s 后才放行。: Between components that claim the whole surface, the next is admitted .5s after the previous one leaves.
text.工作台的时间线和对话组件。: The workspace timeline and chat component.
text.进入时先等一下，防止鼠标路过就触发。: A short wait on entry so a passing pointer triggers nothing.
text.暗。黑色固定搭配荧光绿，只有这一个颜色。: Dark. Black with neon lime, the only colour.
text.亮。中性底加彩色玻璃和分类色。: Light. Neutral base, coloured glass and categories.
text.底永远是中性灰阶，只有这三种东西能有颜色或质感: The base stays neutral; only these three may carry colour or material
text.小块、实色。表示\"当前是这个\"。每个区域一处。: Small and solid. It says "this one". One per region.
text.大块柔光。这一屏的主角，全部由 CSS 绘制。: Large soft light. The lead of the screen, drawn entirely in CSS.
text.灰色点阵是结构，只有表示数据的点才带颜色。: Grey dots are structure; only data dots take colour.
text.每一档都写明用在哪。不在表里的值不能用。: Each step says where it applies. Values outside the table are not used.
text.切换器的立体做法 · 一块面板被挖开，露出更低的一层: The switch in relief · a panel cut open onto a lower layer
text.默认没有。分组靠底色和间距，只有下面四种情况才画线: None by default. Tone and spacing group things; lines appear only in these four cases
text.高度只表示状态或层级，不是装饰: Depth states a level; it never decorates
text.大字负责被看到，小字贴紧成组: Big type gets seen; small type groups tight
text.间距四档：4 / 8 贴紧成组 · 10 卡片之间 · 44 分区之间: Four spacings: 4 / 8 tight groups · 10 between cards · 44 between sections
text.说明原因，并给一个下一步。: Say why, and offer a next step.
text.Story Forge 的完整工作台。Explore 里拖动和缩放画布，用左侧按: The complete Story Forge workspace. In Explore, drag and zoom the canvas and filter materials from the left rail. In Create, switch between Script, Storyboard and Film at Full film, Act, Scene, Beat or Shot scope. Drag the playhead or play the timed still preview. Mention multiple materials at the chat caret; hover the history button to peek, or click to pin it.
text.每一条都按右边的按钮单独看: Play each one with its button
text.正文正文正文正文正文正文正文正文正文正文正文正文正文正文正文正文正文正文: Body text body text body text body text body text body text body text
text..45s 从上滑入，不挤内容: .45s slide in from above, nothing shifts
text.三种让位的判据: How to pick one of three
text.Story Forge 里的真实情况: As it works in Story Forge
text.两者要同时看、互相对照。: Both must be read and compared.
text.上下文面板打开时，阅读列让位；观看时监看视窗放大，侧栏暂时让开。多行输入把时间线: The reading column yields to an open context panel. While watching, the monitor grows and the side panel gives way. Multiline input pushes the timeline up; selecting a clip never changes lane height.
text.悬停历史按钮，聊天记录以毛玻璃浮层盖在时间线上；移开即收起。素材预览使用半透明黑: Hover the history button to peek at a glass overlay above the timeline; it closes when the pointer leaves. Media previews use a translucent black cinema backdrop without changing content scroll room.
text.点击历史按钮固定记录，时间线收起；再次点击恢复。仅聚焦对话不会隐藏时间线，Exp: Click the history button to pin history and collapse the timeline; click again to restore it. Chat focus alone does not hide the timeline. Explore still has no timeline.
text.一样大的格子看不出重点。这里是 Fintech 式总览，以及六种基本布局。: Equal boxes show no priority. A Fintech-style overview and six base layouts.
text.进来第一眼知道该看哪: You know where to look first
text.一眼知道看哪：一张大主图，其他退后: One big lead, the rest recede
text.节点图可拖动节点、连接跟随；右侧配置项能折叠、能拖动排序。下面的业务蓝图来自 P: Drag nodes and links follow; settings on the right fold and reorder. The blueprint below comes from Puzzle: select a region, read its rollup.
text.汇总这一区内所有步骤的成本: Rolls up the cost of every step in this region
text.来源：X 上的 Bot 看板。KPI、切换、通知从顶部滑入，主界面继续更新: From a bot board on X. KPIs and tabs; alerts slide in from the top while the board keeps updating
text.手机上只改变排列，不改变语言：同样的圆角、卡片和信号。悬停在手机上不存在，所以工: Phones change the arrangement, not the language: same radii, cards and signal. Hover does not exist on touch, so tools stay visible and focus comes from a tap.
text.来自站外新参考：AI 产品常用模式，以及一批有记忆点的小组件。全部用本规范的变量: From outside references: common AI patterns and memorable small components, rebuilt with these variables so they follow the scheme.
text.Shot 9 建议用缓慢推近：街道先静下来，音乐再回来。这样观众的注意力会被带到: For Shot 9 I suggest a slow push-in: the street goes quiet, then the music returns. That draws attention to the window, not the dialogue.
text.可以把推近改到第二拍之后。前两拍保持静止，让磁带上的灰尘先被看见。不过这版节奏更: Move the push-in after beat two. Hold still for two beats so the dust on the tape is seen first. It is slower, so judge it with the score.
text.来自 recent.design 和视频，全部用本规范的变量重做: From recent.design and videos, rebuilt with these variables
text.点阵变形：环 → 波 → 鱼 → 球: Dot morph: ring → wave → fish → sphere
text.圆环球：分类色旋转，悬停加速: Ring sphere: category colours spin, faster on hover
text.切片转场：整图 → 竖条 → 点阵 → 整图: Slice transition: whole → strips → dots → whole
text.每个动作都交代它从哪里来。: Every motion says where it came from.
text.不同形状的内容放在同样的底上，悬停出现阴影: Different shapes on one base; a shadow appears on hover
text.日常工作台：文件拖放和多选、看板拖动、日历联动、活动流。: Everyday work: file drop and multi-select, kanban drag, linked calendar, activity.
text.把文件拖到这里，或点击选择: Drop files here, or click to choose
text.任务看板 · 拖动卡片排序和换列: Tasks · drag cards to reorder or change column
text.样片今晚能看吗？: Can we see the rushes tonight?
text.问 Jun 要旧磁带: Ask Jun for the old tapes
text.界面只能从这里取值。源码逐项对照 Story Forge v5。: Interfaces take values only from here. Checked item by item against Story Forge v5.
text.只用在争整块表面的组件之间: Only between components that claim the whole surface
text.阴影不超过 2 层，模糊不超过 48px: At most 2 layers, blur at most 48px
text.行高 1.45，标题 -.022em、680，标签大写: Line height 1.45, headings -.022em at 680, labels uppercase
text.正文 13，卡片内边距 12/14，卡片间距 10，分区 44: Body 13, card padding 12/14, card gap 10, section 44
text.每个来源取什么，不取什么。原始抽帧在 references/frames。: What each source gives and does not. Raw frames are in references/frames.
text.显隐、注意力锁、挤占/覆盖/退场、凹槽切换器、胶片、无限画布、暗色荧光绿。: Visibility, attention lock, push/overlay/retire, recess switch, film, infinite canvas, dark neon lime.
text.交互和数值的主要依据。: Main basis for interaction and values.
text.彩色玻璃卡、疏密对比、点阵图案、黑白胶囊导航。: Coloured glass cards, density contrast, dot patterns, black and white capsule nav.
text.规范册的版式：大标题、整页长卷、样张成组。: Handbook layout: big titles, one long page, grouped samples.
text.六种布局：主区、横带、侧栏、全幅浮动、看板、泳道。: Six layouts: hero, bands, aside, full-bleed floats, kanban, swimlanes.
text.节点卡片内嵌媒体预览、相机参数、连线端口。: Node cards with embedded media, camera parameters, ports.
text.大型流程画布、分组、框选、侧栏成本汇总、状态菜单。: Large process canvas, groups, region selection, side cost rollup, status menu.
text.类别 → 角色发光连线、详情卡联动、提问框。: Category to role glowing links, linked detail card, ask box.
text.KPI、角色、日志、设备预览、错误拦截、完成卡。: KPIs, crew, log, device preview, caught errors, completion card.
text.Effort 滑块、语音光晕、按住打开、时间刻度、点云、素材格、触感按钮。这批都: Effort slider, voice glow, hold to open, time scrubber, point cloud, asset grid, tactile button. Small and memorable.
text.不取：3D 商品和人像这类依赖素材的画面。: Not taken: 3D products and portraits that depend on assets.
text.AI 模式清单：流式文字、建议词、把握提示、重新生成、命令面板、语音输入。: AI patterns: streaming text, suggestion chips, confidence, regenerate, command palette, voice.
text.模式库尚未完成，只取清单。: The library is unfinished; only the list is used.
text.不取：粒子爆炸当常驻背景。: Not taken: particle bursts as a permanent background.
text.icon grid、圆环球、点阵金鱼、整图切片、票根卡、邀请胶囊。: Icon grid, ring sphere, dot-matrix goldfish, image slicing, ticket card, invite pill.
text.不取：卡通角色和人像素材。: Not taken: cartoon characters and portraits.
text.三对明暗，结构完全相同，只换变量。点一张卡片就能切换，整页跟着变。: Three light/dark pairs with the same structure; only variables change. Click a card and the whole page follows.
text.换主题只改一个文件: A theme is one file entry
text.主题是 core/tokens/themes.json 里的一条数据。构建时自动: A theme is one entry in core/tokens/themes.json. The build generates its styles and switcher, and no component code changes. No black-with-cobalt: dark must be cool, and business blue is not. A project picks one pair; its light/dark switch moves within that pair.
text.新增一个主题，要写的就是这些: All it takes to add a theme
text.菜单 · 点开，选完或点外面就收起: Menu · opens on click, closes on choice or outside
text.点一个节点：配置面板挤进来，无关节点变暗。点空白处退出。: Click a node: settings push in and unrelated nodes dim. Click empty space to leave.
text.节点待机只有标题和预览，端口和工具悬停才出现。配置组用握把拖动，也能用键盘 ↑↓: At rest a node is a title and preview; ports and tools appear on hover. Settings drag by grip or sort with ↑↓.
text.来源：Puzzle 视频。悬停预览一组的连线，点击后汇总挤进来: From the Puzzle video. Hover previews a group's links; a click pushes in its rollup
text.点左边切类别；悬停条目预览连线；点条目后详情挤进来，点外面退出: Left switches category; hover previews a link; clicking an item pushes in details, clicking outside leaves
text.把抽象关系变成能探索的空间。来源：X 上的角色地图、抖音的创作面板。彩色主题效果: Turns abstract relations into a space to explore. From a role map on X and a Douyin creator panel. Strongest in coloured themes; single colour in Neon.
text.连线从选中的按钮出发，交代内容从哪里来。: Lines start at the selected button to show where content comes from.
text.来源：X 上的 Android Agent 控制台。播放时只有当前角色亮，其他变: From an Android agent console on X. While playing only the current crew stays lit; click a crew to filter the log.
text.同样的规则：鼠标移上一个，工具出现，别的组件变暗，移走就恢复: The same rules: hover one and its tools appear, the others dim, and everything recovers when the pointer leaves
text.命令面板 · Ctrl K 或点一下，列表盖在内容上: Command palette · Ctrl K or click; the list overlays content
text.同一套规则放进九个日常组件。鼠标移上一个，别的变暗，移走就恢复；确认和保存这类操: One rule set in nine everyday components. Hover one and the others dim until the pointer leaves; actions like confirm and save appear only when needed.
text.纸本主题：暖灰纸面、黑字、一点橙；启动面板的刻度和小标签。: Paper theme: warm paper, black type, a touch of orange; ticks and micro-labels on the boot panel.
text.发光核心、扇形展开、右侧详情；余烬主题的暖黑和骨白细线。: Glowing core, fan-out, detail on the right; Ember's warm black and bone-white lines.
text.一整套颜色变量。三对，每对一亮一暗。: A full set of colour variables. Three pairs, one light and one dark.
text.亮。只有黑白，以白为主。: Light. Black and white only, mostly white.
text.暗。纯黑底加虹彩光，和彩光用同一种玻璃。: Dark. True black with iridescent light; the same glass as Prism.
text.亮。暖灰纸面、黑字和一点橙，像一份精密档案。: Light. Warm paper, black type and a touch of orange, like a precise dossier.
text.暗。暖炭黑、骨白细线和一团橙色余烬。: Dark. Warm charcoal, bone-white lines and one ember of orange.
